column3: The US supreme court has allowed Donald Trump to continue his administration’s construction of a border wall in Texas’s Big Bend region. (美國最高法院已允許唐納·川普繼續其政府在德州大彎曲地區的邊境圍牆施工。)

The nation’s highest court granted the Trump administration’s emergency request to suspend a lower court order that had temporarily stopped the project last month. (國家最高法院批准了川普政府的緊急請求，暫停了上個月暫時停止該項目的下級法院命令。)
Elon Musk and other finance moguls have expressed their support for embattled Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. (伊隆·馬斯克和其他金融大亨已表達了他們對陷入困境的輝達執行長黃仁勳的支持。)
The head of the world’s most valuable chip company faces an internal investigation over a romantic relationship with an alleged Chinese spy. (這家全球最有價值晶片公司的負責人正面臨一項關於與疑似中國間諜發生浪漫關係的內部調查。)
France accuses Iran of cyber 'sabotage' in fridge attacks. (法國指控伊朗在冰箱攻擊事件中進行網路「破壞」。)
France says Iranian military hackers took over refrigeration controllers at around 700 different retail sites last month. (法國表示，伊朗軍事駭客上個月接管了約700個不同零售點的冷藏控制器。)

British comedian Russell Brand sentenced to over 10 years for rape and sexual assault. (英國喜劇演員羅素·布蘭德因強姦與性侵被判處超過10年徒刑。)
Russell Brand was found guilty on one count of rape and three counts of sexual assault in a case brought by six women. (羅素·布蘭德在六名女性提起的案件中，被裁定一項強姦罪與三項性侵罪成立。)
